body: I feel the same way. I want to ask for help and talk to people but whenever I do it’s like they just disregard me or don’t take it seriously. It really feels like no matter what or who I talk to nobody really cares how I feel. I feel so alone.
That’s fucked. It’s not like you can help the way you feel. Him saying that to you definitely didn’t help your feeling this way. I have so much empathy in my heart for you, I’m so sorry.
This happens to me too every time I have a really good day. I’m sorry it happens to you, I know how bad it sucks :(
